author: A3 (Lane A)
definition: Grammatically POSSIBLE English that sounds unnatural due to Vietnamese L1 transfer. Distinct from (a) the correction engine, which fixes clear errors — every positive here is left UNCHANGED by correctWithTutorRules; and (b) vinglish-detector.ts, which catches literal VN code-switch tokens — every positive here is all-English with no VN tokens.
verifiedAgainst: origin/main d895cee0 (correctWithTutorRules leaves all positives status=unchanged; detectVietlishDark fires on positives, abstains on negatives)
collisionAvoidance: Patterns chosen to NOT overlap live Lane-A worktrees/MRs: a1/although-even-though-but, a1/because-so-doubling, lane-a/existential-have-there-is-are, lane-a/vietlish-very-like (MR !381).

patterns.name: First-person 'according to me/us' opinion calque
patterns.vietnameseRoot: theo tôi / theo ý kiến của tôi -> 'according to me'. Native: 'in my opinion'.
patterns.fp_risk_note: Only first-person 'according to me/us' is the VN marker. Third-party/source 'according to him/her/them/the report/the data/the law' is fully natural and MUST abstain.

positive.input: According to me, this film is very good.
According to us, the plan is fine.
The result, according to me, is unfair.

negative.input: In my opinion, this film is very good.
According to the report, sales went up.
According to her, the meeting is at five.

patterns.name: Fronted NP topic + resumptive subject pronoun
patterns.vietnameseRoot: Topic-prominent transfer: 'Quê tôi, nó rất đẹp' -> 'My hometown, it is very beautiful.' Native: 'My hometown is very beautiful.'
patterns.fp_risk_note: Fires only when the pre-comma chunk is a bare NP (no finite verb / no who/which/that) followed by ', it/they/he/she + be/aux'. Non-restrictive appositives and relative clauses ('My brother, who lives in Hue, is a teacher'; 'Hanoi, the capital, is crowded') MUST abstain. Anchored to sentence start.

positive.input: My hometown, it is very beautiful.
My family, they are very kind.
The weather here, it was terrible yesterday.

negative.input: My brother, who lives in Hue, is a teacher.

patterns.name: 'play' + electronic device/app object
patterns.vietnameseRoot: chơi điện thoại / chơi Facebook -> 'play the phone / play Facebook'. Native: 'use my phone / scroll Facebook / be on the computer'.
patterns.fp_risk_note: Object is a CLOSED device/app whitelist (phone, facebook, computer, internet, tiktok, zalo, youtube, laptop, ipad). Real 'play' objects — piano/guitar/football/soccer/a game/cards/chess/music/a song — MUST abstain.

positive.input: I play the phone every night before sleep.
My brother plays computer after school.

negative.input: I play the piano every evening.
We play a game after dinner.

patterns.name: 'too + praise adjective' as intensifier (quá)
patterns.vietnameseRoot: quá ngon / quá đẹp -> 'too delicious / too beautiful' meaning 'so/really'. Native: 'so delicious'.
patterns.fp_risk_note: HIGHEST FP of the set — dark-only, low confidence. Guards: (a) adjective from a CLOSED positive-praise whitelist (excludes ambivalent sweet/spicy/hot/expensive/big where 'too' genuinely means excess); (b) abstains when a 'to <verb>' / 'for <obj>' complement follows ('too good to be true', 'too beautiful for words'). Residual FP remains where praise adjectives carry a real excess reading ('too sweet for me' is excluded by whitelist, but 'too nice' can occasionally mean 'excessively nice'). See B handoff.

positive.input: Ha Long Bay is too beautiful.
Your new dress is too nice.

negative.input: The coffee is too hot to drink.
This bag is too expensive for me.
It was too good to be true.

patterns.name: Subjectless sentence-initial 'Wish you ...' greeting
patterns.vietnameseRoot: Chúc bạn một ngày tốt lành -> 'Wish you a nice day'. Native: 'I wish you ... / Have a nice day'.
patterns.fp_risk_note: Fires only sentence-initial and subjectless. With a subject ('I/We wish you ...') it is natural and MUST abstain. The counterfactual ellipsis 'Wish you were/had/would/could ...' ('Wish you were here') MUST abstain.

positive.input: Wish you good health and happiness.
Wish you success in your new job.

negative.input: I wish you a nice day.
We wish you a merry Christmas.
Wish you were here with us.
